gate: 0.2 - do the five error fields populate in test mode?
verdict: PARTIAL PASS - field SHAPE confirmed, reason VOCABULARY not exercisable

what_passed.error_code_matches_docs: BAD_REQUEST_ERROR carries a customer-side decline, exactly as docs/razorpay-api-notes.md warned - which is why classification must NOT key on error_code
what_passed.error_source_varies_meaningfully: gateway (card) vs issuer (wallet) - the field does discriminate, so it is worth keying on

what_failed.error_reason_is_generic: Both payments returned 'payment_failed'. Test card 4100 2800 0008 0001 is documented to map to 'insufficient_fund'; driving the success/failure screen to FAILURE overrides the card mapping and yields the generic reason instead.
what_failed.spelling_question_unresolved: The docs use both 'insufficient_fund' and 'insufficient_funds'. Neither spelling was observed, so this stays unanswered.
what_failed.consequence: The ~121-value error_reason taxonomy CANNOT be observed from test mode via this route. The diagnosis layer must seed its reason vocabulary from Razorpay's published enumeration and declare it documentation-derived, not observed. The field SHAPE above is observed and can be claimed as such.

fields.error_description: Your payment didn't go through due to a temporary issue. Any debited amount will be refunded in 4-5 business days.

gate_0_4_status_at_capture.note: Two payments FAILED at 10:59:41 and 11:00:39 with the webhook active and subscribed to payment.failed, and the endpoint verified healthy. Neither a delivery nor a rejected delivery was seen, so Razorpay did not call the endpoint.
